observation: The requested UI is in the Expo/React Native app under apps/mobile; active sessions use a TUI-like bottom composer on the Session page.

ActiveSessionScreen delegates to SessionScreen, which wraps the timeline and Composer in a KeyboardAvoidingView. Composer renders a multiline Prompt TextInput using styles.promptInput; current style has minHeight 86, lineHeight 24, paddingVertical 12, and no maxHeight or scrollEnabled prop.
Prior keyboard work added KeyboardAvoidingView and timeline bottom-stickiness; current input-height fix can remain a localized composer/TextInput style change without protocol changes.
